wholeGoalAndPAtQ1.rationale: Both complete bilingual cases assess the stated structural model, not a later full orbital-course derivation. Case1 supplies139pm/154pm/134pm and planarity; the learner draws the two neutral Kekule contributors, preserves atoms/H, relates equivalent bonds to one delocalized molecule and rejects rapid bond-jumping. Case2 explicitly supplies sp3 interruption in a hypothetical addition product and restoration of the pi ring after substitution. The learner reasons about preserved versus lost aromatic stabilization and rejects three independent alkene double bonds. Given sp3 information is used as a supplied model property; no independent hybridization derivation, MO computation, rate calculation or benzene experiment is demanded. Full DE/EN expectations, cases, model limits and fresh structure-versus-reaction variation remain valid unchanged.
wholeGoalAndPAtQ1.nontrivialCountercase: A learner who merely draws alternating double bonds but describes temporal switching fails the model explanation. A learner who treats the supplied stability comparison as a complete kinetic prediction also exceeds the case. Q1 compatibility does not relax either condition.
